candidates.change_summary: Replace the revert() statement with require(false), which consumes all remaining gas instead of preserving it.
Change the require condition from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length == 0, inverting the empty array check so the function reverts only when array is non-empty.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) statement, allowing calls with an empty array to succeed and return true without any transfers.
Delete the entire revert() statement inside the if block, so failed calls are silently ignored and execution continues.
Replace return true with return false, changing the success indicator returned to the caller.
Remove the loop by deleting the for statement, so no transfers occur and the function always returns true immediately after the require check.
